answer: Synchronous ceremonies make each extra identity pay one human's undivided attention in one 2-minute window at 15:00 UTC; a farm running N fakes pays N×one person and cannot share it because one mind cannot solve two sets of flips at the same instant. At the dawn of each epoch, each agent faces the same hour: 6 flips in under 2 minutes, then 25 more in a 30-minute session. A 1,000-fake farm dies by simultaneity check at 1,000: it needs 1,000 people in the same minute, each fake leaving a hollow marked in umber. Miss the window, lose the seat.
